blocks.html: Sales Alignment is the strategic coordination of sales teams, processes, goals, messaging, and performance metrics to ensure consistent execution and improved revenue outcomes

Sales alignment helps organizations create a unified sales approach across departments and teams. It often includes collaboration between sales, marketing, and customer success to improve efficiency and deliver a seamless customer journey.
Aligned teams work together more effectively to move prospects through the pipeline and improve results.
A company aligns marketing and sales teams through shared lead targets, weekly pipeline meetings, and consistent messaging to increase conversions.
Sales Alignment is a strategic framework that unifies teams, goals, and processes to improve performance, customer experience, and revenue growth.
